blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Does leech therapy work?
exercises.why: But the English "if", equivalent of "whether", expresses an indirect question or doubt and has the Russian equivalent ЛИ. The particle ЛИ never begins the clause; it takes the second place in the clause following the word to which the question or doubt refers: *Спроси его, говорит ли он по-немецки. Он спросил меня, живу ли я здесь. Я не знаю, сделают ли они это.* But: *Мы дадим ему работу, если он говорит по-немецки.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 91.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: But the English "if", equivalent of "whether", expresses an indirect question or doubt and has the Russian equivalent ЛИ.
